description: Every indexed family of nonempty subsets of a given well-ordered set has a unique function assigning to each index the least member of its corresponding subset. In particular, this is a choice function for the whole family, including an empty family.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.well_ordered_family_choice.{u, v} {ι : Type u} {α : Type v} [LinearOrder α] [WellFoundedLT α]
  (A : ι → Set α) (hA : ∀ (i : ι), (A i).Nonempty) : ∃! c, ∀ (i : ι), IsLeast (A i) (c i)
